meta.title: Recreate Order: Create Order with default values succeeds

plan.title: Recreate live RFQ order with defaults

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's summary page.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order, leaving its window open.
Submit the Recreate Order window without changing its default values.
Verify that order creation succeeded with the expected toast.
Verify that the Recreate Order window closed after successful creation.
